title: Coherent formal modules are closed under binary products
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf. For any two coherent adic inverse systems [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], the vertex of every limiting binary product cone in the ambient category of inverse systems of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is again a coherent adic inverse system.

source.place: Section 0EHN and Lemma 087X, binary-sum argument written out

proof.text: Form the termwise biproduct with diagonal transitions. Coherence follows from the coherent kernel/cokernel/biproduct theorem. On affine opens the ideal-product section calculation gives I^r(F ⊕ G)=I^rF ⊕ I^rG and identifies the quotient with the sum of quotients. Hence annihilation and the given quotient-transition isomorphisms are preserved. Glue the canonical maps and transport the three conditions to any other binary limit via its unique isomorphism.
